task.description:
Write integration tests for ISS-204 and ISS-206.

Files:
- tests/specs/ISS-204.md + tests/integration/iss204_audit_transaction_test.zig
- tests/specs/ISS-206.md + tests/integration/iss206_token_multiset_test.zig

ISS-204 cases: (1) commit event → audit row exists in same tx; (2) crash-injection (simulated tx rollback) → both audit and event absent; (3) before_state/after_state captured correctly.

ISS-206 cases: (1) parallel split creates tokens with distinct token_ids; (2) join advances only when all branch tokens arrive; (3) cancelled branch subtracts from expected count; (4) replay round-trip produces identical active_tokens + join_counters.

Real PostgreSQL, per-test UUIDs, no mocks, no SkipZigTest.
acceptance_criteria: Spec + test files for ISS-204 and ISS-206 covering listed cases
